page.overview:
What is Master Sword?

Temple of Time Hyrule Castle Korok Forest Light Dragon

The is a recurring legendary Magic Sword in the , best known for being the trademark weapon of the main protagonist Link. Due to its long history of destroying or sealing away evil with the power of light, it has been referred to by many titles, the two most notable being the Blade of Evil's Bane, and the Sword that Seals the Darkness. For this reason, unlike most other swords, the Master Sword plays an important role in nearly the whole series since A Link to the Past, where it made its first appearance.

The Master Sword is often seen to choose or accept its master by its own will, always a hero who has gone through great trials that test his power, wisdom, and courage (much like the balance of the Triforce) to prove him worthy of wielding it by pulling it from its pedestal where the blade rests. This may be the conscious choice of the sword's spirit, Fi, who sleeps eternally within the sword and only assists her heroic master.

Despite being primarily associated with Link, few other characters in the series are also known to wield the Master Sword.

Also known as: Blade of Evil's Bane, Sword of Evil's Bane.
